plaintext.source: Interlinear decipherment in Ludwig Camerarius's hand over most cipher words; lines y1502-y1709 unglossed, with a clear paraphrase in the left margin.

transcription.source: MDZ IIIF images of the BSB microfilm (bsb00117497, scan 1202)
transcription.notes: One pass by an AI agent, no independent reader. Line ends lost in the gutter fold of the microfilm. Transcribed on masked strips (glosses blanked) before the glosses were read: the held-out page.

system.summary: Homophonic substitution of Latin letters by numbers 1-99 written with dots between groups, about ten extra signs, and 3-digit code groups for names (217.11.99 and 218.88 King of Sweden, 307 Principes). Cipher words embedded in clear Latin. Two to nine homophones per letter; u after q not written. Some groups take two letter values.
system.notes: Same system as targets/rakoczi1632 (fol. 491r). Several values seen for {s}, {a}, {x}, {c} and 68; new signs {w} and {f} on 492v.

prior_solution.where: Camerarius's interlinear decipherment on the same pages; WAINUT's target rakoczi1632 (key and fol. 491r, 3 Nov 2026; Szilágyi 1873 and 1882 searched, no printed text). Fol. 491v-492v not done there (no change since 4 Nov 2026, last commit 4e0b8af13).

conditions.human_role: WAINUT built the key and read fol. 491r. Brice Dudout set the rules (protocol hashed before transcription, one held-out measurement, thresholds fixed in advance, Daniel's count). An AI agent transcribed, measured, read and wrote up. No human palaeographer checked the text.
tools: scripts in this folder (key completion, held-out measure)
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Fol. 491v and 492r transcribed with their glosses; fol. 492v transcribed on masked strips (glosses blanked) after the protocol was hashed.
WAINUT's key_frozen.tsv (72 entries) applied unchanged; it agrees with 97.0% of the letters of the glossed pairs of 491v-492r.
8 values added by script from the glossed pairs of 491v-492r (35 i, 55 x, 69 h, 81 l, {O} e, {f} l; second values 44 t, {s} l); key K frozen by SHA-256 before the glosses of 492v were read.

One measurement on 492v: 31 glossed words, 205 letters, score 0.902 against 0.341 for the best of 200 shuffled keys (margin 0.561); thresholds >= 0.85 and >= 0.30 fixed in advance. key_frozen alone 0.878, margin 0.571.
237 cipher words of 491v-492v: 110 certain, 47 probable, 66 restored (gutter fold), 14 unresolved; 66.2% (94.1% with the restored words).

outcome.method_basis: WAINUT's key (built on the glosses of fol. 491r) applied to fol. 491v-492v, with 8 values added from the glosses of 491v-492r; most cipher words also carry Camerarius's gloss, so most of the content is existing.

validation.notes: Contributor's pre-registered held-out test (not docs/_validate.py): protocol hashed before transcription; H = all of fol. 492v, transcribed on masked strips; key frozen before the glosses of H were read; one measurement: 0.902 vs 0.341 for the best of 200 shuffled keys (margin 0.561), 31 words, 205 letters. Thresholds >= 0.85 and >= 0.30 fixed in advance. One mask incident (line y590 excluded) and one exclusion rule set before the measure, declared in validation.txt.

texts.label: fol. 491v
texts.summary: Defence of Rákóczi's estates and heirs; 500,000 florins a year in two instalments, the first year in one sum before he takes the field; 16,000 German foot and 4,000 cuirassiers whose officers swear to him; the Kingdom of Hungary.

reading_review.note: Read by sense against Camerarius's glosses; one AI reader, no independent or human review; count manual.
